description:
## What

After all H1–H11 + N1–N3 land:

1. Verify `chain_walk` LOC < 100. If not, file a follow-up bead identifying which extraction(s) need to go further.
2. Verify `check_name_constraints` LOC < 100. Same fallback.
3. If `#[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]` was added at any point during the refactor, remove it.
4. Run `cargo clippy --all-features -p pkix-path -- -W clippy::too_many_lines -D warnings` to confirm both functions pass even with the lint enabled.
5. Update the 2017–2024 doc-comment that argued AGAINST decomposition (per design §0: "any refactor must retire that comment honestly"). Replace with a concise pointer to the helper structure and the RFC §6.1 step map.
6. Update CHANGELOG.md with a summary of the decomposition under the next minor-version section.
7. Close PKIX-als9 with a summary referencing all completed child beads.

## Dependencies

- H11 (last sequenced helper).
- N3 (independent of H1–H11 but blocks check_name_constraints LOC verification).

## Acceptance

- chain_walk and check_name_constraints both under 100 lines.
- clippy --warn=too_many_lines clean.
- 2017–2024 doc comment retired.
- CHANGELOG.md updated.
- PKIX-als9 closed.
title: als9: cleanup — verify <100 lines, retire monolith doc-comment, close epic
